deadline.value: Apply by January 4 (2027) for Fall 2027 to be considered for department support.
deadline.quote: The application deadline is January 4 annually for those interested in Department support.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The supplemental application asks you to list faculty you want to work with; having a faculty contact is expected.
supervisor.quote: The Supplemental Application asks that you indicate your top three areas of interest, to list the faculty members with whom you’d like to work

also.quote: If the fee is a burden, discuss with your faculty contact.

funding.value: Funding (TA, RA or PA) goes to the most highly qualified applicants; non-native English speakers can't TA in year one unless their degree was from an English-speaking university.
funding.quote: Financial support is available to the most highly qualified applicants.

entry_route.value: A BS or BA is required; you can enter with a bachelor's in geology or a related field.
entry_route.quote: A BS or BA is required. Graduate students may enter the department with a bachelor’s degree in geology or a related earth science, or some other field relevant to the intended field of specialization.

fee_waiver.value: The department may have money for fee waivers; discuss with your faculty contact.
fee_waiver.quote: The department may have funding available for fee waivers.
